svg.title: Reward hacking and process-weight decay
svg.desc: Recorded training rewards for fixed process weight and decayed process weight. Faint traces connect recorded observations; thick traces are centered five-observation means. The shaded window spans updates 20 to 30. Lambda decays cubically from 0.5 to zero over that window, then stays zero. Decayed outcome observations begin at update 21. These are individual training runs, not independent-seed averages.
